articles.title_en: Resilient food security information systems in the age of disruption: An ecosystem approach
articles.title_cn: 动荡时代的韧性粮食安全信息系统：一种生态系统方法
articles.abstract_en: Food security information systems (FSIS) face unprecedented threats from abrupt shifts in political and funding priorities, misinformation, and manipulation. We draw on 50 years of research inFood Policyand the broader FSIS literature to offer five resilience characteristics to guide development of a future-fit FSIS: (1) safeguard integrity and impartiality; (2) ensure independent and transparent governance; (3) optimize data and analysis value streams for decision-making; (4) break down sectoral barriers for holistic food security characterization; and (5) innovate responsibly while embedding accountability and learning. We suggest recommended actions based on these resilience characteristics to co-create a more resilient FSIS ecosystem to guide humanitarian responses, advance preventive action for acute crises, and efficiently deliver results.
articles.abstract_cn: 粮食安全信息系统（FSIS）面临来自政治和资金优先事项的突然转变、错误信息和操纵的前所未有的威胁。我们借鉴《食品政策》50年的研究以及更广泛的FSIS文献，提出了五个韧性特征，以指导未来适用的FSIS的发展：（1）维护完整性和公正性；（2）确保独立透明的治理；（3）优化数据和价值链以支持决策；（4）打破部门壁垒以实现整体粮食安全特征描述；（5）在嵌入问责制和学习的同时负责任地创新。我们基于这些韧性特征建议采取行动，共同创建更具韧性的FSIS生态系统，以指导人道主义响应，推进急性危机的预防性行动，并高效地交付成果。

Tracking the affordability of least-cost healthy diets helps guide intervention for food security and improved nutrition
articles.title_cn: 追踪最低成本健康饮食的可负担性有助于指导粮食安全与营养改善的干预措施
articles.abstract_en: This Policy Comment describes how the Food Policy article entitled “Cost and affordability of nutritious diets at retail prices: Evidence from 177 countries” (first published October 2020) and “Retail consumer price data reveal gaps and opportunities to monitor food systems for nutrition” (first published September 2021) advanced the use of least-cost benchmark diets to monitor and improve food security. Those papers contributed to the worldwide use of least-cost diets as a new diagnostic indicator of food access, helping to distinguish among causes of poor diet quality related to high prices, low incomes, or displacement by other food options, thereby guiding intervention toward universal access to healthy diets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本政策评论描述了《食品政策》文章“零售价格下营养饮食的成本与可负担性：来自177个国家的证据”（首次发表于2020年十月）和“零售消费价格数据揭示监测粮食系统营养状况的空白与机遇”（首次发表于2021年九月）如何推进了最低成本基准饮食在监测和改善粮食安全方面的应用。这些论文促进了最低成本饮食作为食物获取新诊断指标在全球范围内的使用，有助于区分与高价格、低收入或其他食品选择替代相关的饮食质量差的原因，从而指导干预措施以实现全民健康饮食的可及性。

articles.title_en: Creating awareness and informing policy: Implications of Buzby and Hyman’s food loss estimates in the United States
articles.title_cn: 提升意识与指导政策：Buzby和Hyman在美国食物损失估算中的启示
articles.abstract_en: •Buzby and Hyman are among the first to quantify the total and per capita economic value of food loss in the U.S.•Findings informed domestic and global policy and shaped the development of sustainable development goals for food loss.•The study had lasting impacts on policy, research, and sustainability efforts through the supply chain to consumer level.
articles.abstract_cn: •Buzby和Hyman是最早量化美国食物损失总经济价值及人均经济价值的研究者之一。•其研究结果影响了国内及全球政策，并推动了食物损失可持续发展目标的制定。•该研究通过供应链至消费者层面，对政策、研究和可持续性努力产生了持久影响。

articles.title_en: Multi-scalar policy uptake of the six-dimensional food security framework
articles.title_cn: 六维粮食安全框架的多尺度政策采纳
articles.abstract_en: In 2022, along with colleagues, we proposed a six-dimensional food security framework in a Food Policy viewpoint article that argued for the need to expand the commonly cited four pillar approach (availability, access, utilization and stability) by adding two additional dimensions: agency and sustainability. The proposal was not just for a new conceptual framework for scholarly analysis, but also for its application in policy settings. Over three years later, we are humbled to see widespread uptake of our call to embrace agency and sustainability as dimensions of food security in multiple tyles of policy settings at different scales. This brief policy comment outlines the growing recognition and application of the six-dimensional framework for food security in policy contexts from the global to the local level. We are hopeful that the growing application of this idea will help to make improvements in the global quest to end hunger.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2022年，我们与同事在《Food Policy》观点文章中提出了六维粮食安全框架，主张在常引用的四支柱方法（可获得性、获取、利用和稳定性）基础上增加两个维度：能动性和可持续性。该提议不仅是为了学术分析的新概念框架，也是为了其在政策环境中的应用。三年多后，我们谦卑地看到，我们关于将能动性和可持续性作为粮食安全维度的呼吁，在不同尺度的多种政策环境中得到了广泛采纳。这篇简短的政策评论概述了六维粮食安全框架在全球到地方层面的政策背景下日益增长的认可和应用。我们希望这一理念的日益应用将有助于在全球消除饥饿的努力中取得进展。

articles.title_en: Policy comment on innovating Australian RD&E institutions: A triple-helix policy framework for sustainable food systems
articles.title_cn: 关于创新澳大利亚研发与推广机构的政策评论：可持续食品系统的三重螺旋政策框架
articles.abstract_en: •Misaligned food policies and siloed governance undermine food system transformation.•Stagnated RD&E institutions hinder shifts to systems-based policy innovations.•Integrating government, academia and industry through a triple-helix policy framework.•Catalyse policy innovations to transform food systems for sustainable development.•Three actions proposed to scale and sustain a triple-helix model for RD&E.
articles.abstract_cn: •不一致的食品政策和孤立的治理削弱了食品系统的转型。•停滞的研发与推广机构阻碍了向基于系统的政策创新的转变。•通过三重螺旋政策框架整合政府、学术界和产业界。•催化政策创新，以转型食品系统，促进可持续发展。•提出了三项行动，以扩展和维持研发与推广的三重螺旋模型。

articles.title_en: Food price stabilization: theory and lessons from experience
articles.title_cn: 食品价格稳定：理论与经验教训
articles.abstract_en: Many countries pursue food price stabilization through public grain reserves (also called buffer stocks or strategic grain reserves) or trade policy. Views of the economics profession on food price stabilization have evolved over time, however, with increased skepticism about economic planning and government market interventions since the mid-1980s. Nonetheless, recent spikes in international commodity prices during the Covid-19 pandemic and at the start of the war in Ukraine have stimulated another wave of interest in establishing or expanding strategic grain reserves and food-based safety net programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家通过公共粮食储备（也称为缓冲库存或战略粮食储备）或贸易政策来追求食品价格稳定。然而，经济学界对食品价格稳定的看法随时间演变，自1980年代中期以来，对经济规划和政府市场干预的怀疑态度有所增加。尽管如此，最近在Covid-19大流行期间以及乌克兰战争初期国际大宗商品价格的飙升，再次激发了建立或扩大战略粮食储备和基于食品的安全网计划的兴趣。

articles.title_en: Review: untangling the complex economics of the local food retail environment
articles.title_cn: 综述：解开本地食品零售环境的复杂经济学
articles.abstract_en: The local food retail environment—or the stores, restaurants and other vendors where households acquire the majority of their food—has long been of interest to researchers and policy makers who care about the connections between it and household outcomes like diet, health, and consumer welfare. The local food retail environment, its characteristics and household outcomes are jointly determined by household and firm decisions through complex economic interactions, making it often difficult to parse out causality and important to have clear, shared definitions. This article highlights, reviews, synthesizes, and discusses current research on the complex economic relationships between households and the local food retail environment. We dedicate extra attention to a discussion and review of the economics behind understanding the association between market concentration and food outcomes of interest. Moreover, we discuss the necessity of understanding these relationships for impactful research and improved policy making.
articles.abstract_cn: 本地食品零售环境——即家庭获取大部分食品的商店、餐馆和其他供应商——长期以来一直受到关注其与家庭结果（如饮食、健康和消费者福利）之间联系的研究人员和政策制定者的关注。本地食品零售环境、其特征及家庭结果是由家庭和企业的决策通过复杂的经济互动共同决定的，这使得解析因果关系往往困难重重，并且明确、共享的定义至关重要。本文重点介绍、回顾、综合并讨论了关于家庭与本地食品零售环境之间复杂经济关系的当前研究。我们特别关注并回顾了理解市场集中度与感兴趣的食物结果之间关联背后的经济学。此外，我们讨论了理解这些关系对于产生有影响力的研究和改进政策制定的必要性。

articles.title_en: Mitigating food security impacts from crisis in high-income countries: lessons from different contexts
articles.title_cn: 缓解高收入国家危机中的粮食安全影响：不同情境下的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: Recent global events, including COVID-19 and the Russia-Ukraine war, have brought to light vulnerabilities in global food supply chains. As a result, domestic food security in crisis situations is increasingly a topic of concern even in high-income countries. However, to date, there is limited literature to inform crisis response policy for food security in high-income countries. At the same time, related strands of literature from other crisis and country contexts offer relevant policy conclusions to inform the evidence base and identify areas for future research. This article expands the scope of analysis to review five related bodies of work, with the major aim of identifying findings relevant for food security policy in high-income countries in crises. First, we consider analysis related to food security policy in general crises contexts from the 1) disaster risk management in food and agriculture and 2) food and agricultural supply chain resilience literatures. Then, we turn to country context-specific findings, reviewing 3) food security policy in crisis situations in low- and middle-income countries, 4) food security policy outside of crisis in high-income countries, and finishing with the major focus of our review on nascent literature related to 5) food security policy in crisis situations in high-income countries. The review concludes by highlighting common themes relevant to food security policy and identifying research gaps to be addressed by future work.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期全球事件，包括COVID-19和俄罗斯-乌克兰战争，揭示了全球粮食供应链的脆弱性。因此，即使在危机情境下，高收入国家的国内粮食安全也日益成为关注话题。然而，迄今为止，关于高收入国家危机应对粮食安全政策的文献有限。同时，来自其他危机和国家情境的相关文献提供了相关的政策结论，为证据基础提供信息并识别未来研究领域。本文扩展分析范围，回顾五个相关研究领域，主要目的是识别与高收入国家危机中粮食安全政策相关的发现。首先，我们考虑一般危机情境下粮食安全政策的相关分析，来自1)粮食和农业灾害风险管理以及2)粮食和农业供应链韧性文献。然后，我们转向特定国家情境的发现，回顾3)低收入和中等收入国家危机情境下的粮食安全政策，4)高收入国家非危机情境下的粮食安全政策，并以我们回顾的主要焦点——关于5)高收入国家危机情境下粮食安全政策的新兴文献——作为结束。回顾最后强调了与粮食安全政策相关的共同主题，并指出了未来工作需解决的研究空白。

articles.title_en: Firm’s responses to food policies to reduce consumption of ultra-processed food and beverages: lessons from the existing evidence
articles.title_cn: 企业应对减少超加工食品和饮料消费的食品政策的策略：来自现有证据的教训
articles.abstract_en: Food policies seeking to lower the intake of ultra-processed foods and beverages (a risk factor for obesity and related cardiovascular diseases) are gaining traction. Producer behaviors toward these policies can affect whether policies achieve public health goals. In this narrative review, we synthesize available evidence from ex-ante and ex-post studies since 2015 to assess strategic responses by the food industry to a broad set of mandatory food policies on ultra-processed foods and beverages, including taxes, labeling, marketing restrictions, and claims. Based on 49 papers, we found strategic pricing as the most prevalent assessed producer response, followed by product reformulation, and changes in product portfolio (product entry or exit), marketing, and package size. Evidence to date points towards product reformulation and portfolio changes reinforcing the public health goal for food policies, as these producer responses improve the nutrient profile of available products, albeit unintended consequences can emerge via the use of non-sugar sweeteners. Strategic pricing can strengthen public health goals for food policies when unhealthy products become relatively more expensive than expected compared to healthier options. Otherwise, strategic pricing works against these goals. Mixed results arise from changes in marketing as their post-policy sales effectiveness can shrink, but producers can increase the marketing intensity of unhealthy foods. Evidence of package size changes is scarce and inconclusive. The overall implications of strategic producer responses will depend on market structure and share, their magnitude and scope (producers often respond in a mixture of ways), and how consumers adjust their demand in consequence. Policymakers and researchers should account for strategic producer responses in the policy design and evaluation process.
articles.abstract_cn: 旨在降低超加工食品和饮料（肥胖及相关心血管疾病的危险因素）摄入量的食品政策正日益受到关注。生产者对这些政策的行为可能影响政策是否实现公共卫生目标。在本叙述性综述中，我们综合了自2015年以来事前和事后研究的现有证据，以评估食品行业对一系列强制性超加工食品和饮料政策（包括税收、标签、营销限制和声明）的战略性反应。基于49篇论文，我们发现战略性定价是最普遍评估的生产者反应，其次是产品重新配方，以及产品组合（产品进入或退出）、营销和包装尺寸的变化。迄今为止的证据表明，产品重新配方和组合变化强化了食品政策的公共卫生目标，因为这些生产者反应改善了现有产品的营养状况，尽管通过使用非糖甜味剂可能会出现意外后果。当不健康产品相对于更健康选项变得比预期更昂贵时，战略性定价可以加强食品政策的公共卫生目标。否则，战略性定价会阻碍这些目标。营销变化的结果好坏参半，因为政策后的销售效果可能缩小，但生产者可以增加不健康食品的营销强度。包装尺寸变化的证据稀缺且不确定。战略性生产者反应的总体影响将取决于市场结构和份额、其规模和范围（生产者通常以多种方式混合反应），以及消费者如何相应地调整其需求。政策制定者和研究人员应在政策设计和评估过程中考虑战略性生产者反应。

articles.title_en: A scoping review of (dis-)incentives for animal welfare-improving farming practices
articles.title_cn: 关于改善动物福利养殖实践的（去）激励因素的范围综述
articles.abstract_en: Public interest in improving farm animal welfare has increased in recent years, but research on implementation of on-farm enhanced welfare practices lags behind. This review examines the incentives and barriers to adoption of animal welfare-improving farming practices from the perspective of key stakeholders: farmers and other animal product producers. We perform a machine-learning aided scoping review of the academic literature studying how different rearing practices influence economic outcomes for producers, providing direct evidence on the (dis-)incentives of adopting the practices studied. This allows us to (1) identify existing consensus and (2) highlight research gaps on the economic factors related to adoption of (or lack of) welfare-improved practices. Operating costs emerge as a near-universal disincentive for welfare-improving practices. Conversely, improved indoor environment shows potential benefits for animal health and productivity, suggesting the possibility of interventions that have only negligible impacts on overall profits. These takeaways are drawn from a relatively sparse literature, underscoring important research gaps. Addressing these gaps can inform evidence-based policies that align practice with public expectations for farm animal welfare while being cognizant of producer constraints and incentives.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，公众对改善农场动物福利的兴趣有所增加，但关于农场内增强福利实践实施的研究相对滞后。本综述从关键利益相关者——农民及其他动物产品生产者的视角，考察了采用改善动物福利养殖实践的激励因素与障碍。我们采用机器学习辅助的范围综述方法，对研究不同饲养实践如何影响生产者经济结果的学术文献进行了梳理，为所研究实践的采用（去）激励因素提供了直接证据。这使我们能够（1）识别现有共识，（2）突出与福利改善实践采用（或缺乏）相关的经济因素研究空白。运营成本几乎普遍成为福利改善实践的障碍。相反，改善室内环境对动物健康和生产力的潜在益处表明，可能存在对整体利润影响微乎其微的干预措施。这些结论源自相对稀疏的文献，凸显了重要的研究空白。填补这些空白可以为基于证据的政策提供信息，使实践与公众对农场动物福利的期望保持一致，同时兼顾生产者的约束与激励。

articles.title_en: Urbanizing food environments in Africa: Challenges and opportunities for improving accessibility, affordability, convenience, and desirability of healthy diets
articles.title_cn: 非洲城市化中的食物环境：改善健康饮食的可及性、可负担性、便利性和可取性的挑战与机遇
articles.abstract_en: Food environments are changing in a rapidly urbanizing Africa. These changes have important dietary consequences in a region already contending with the triple burden of malnutrition. In this article, we first discuss the challenges associated with defining and measuring food environments in low- and middle-income countries and present recent progress in developing context-appropriate indicators and tools. Further, using mixed methods scoping reviews, we examine how urbanizing food environments affect diets and nutrition in Africa, differentiating between various food environment domains, namely food accessibility, affordability, convenience, and desirability. The findings suggest that urbanization improves stable access to more diverse and nutritious foods. At the same time, urbanizing food environments make ultra-processed foods and other convenient but unhealthy food choices more accessible, affordable, and desirable, contributing to overweight, obesity, and chronic disease risk. We discuss several policy options to improve the healthfulness of food environments, including industry and retail regulation, product labeling, taxes and subsidies, and school feeding programs, among others. National and local policy approaches need to be context-specific and considered within the wider political economy of food environments. We also mention further research needs in terms of measuring food environments and evaluating the effects of policy interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在快速城市化的非洲，食物环境正在发生变化。这些变化对该地区已经面临营养不良三重负担的饮食产生了重要影响。在本文中，我们首先讨论了在中低收入国家定义和衡量食物环境所面临的挑战，并介绍了在制定适合背景的指标和工具方面的最新进展。此外，通过混合方法范围审查，我们考察了城市化中的食物环境如何影响非洲的饮食和营养，区分了食物环境的各个领域，即食物可及性、可负担性、便利性和可取性。研究结果表明，城市化改善了对更多样化和营养丰富食物的稳定获取。与此同时，城市化中的食物环境使超加工食品和其他方便但不健康的食物选择更加可及、可负担和可取，增加了超重、肥胖和慢性病风险。我们讨论了几种改善食物环境健康性的政策选择，包括行业和零售监管、产品标签、税收和补贴以及学校供餐计划等。国家和地方的政策方法需要针对具体背景，并在更广泛的食物环境政治经济中加以考虑。我们还提到了在衡量食物环境和评估政策干预效果方面的进一步研究需求。

articles.title_en: A systematic review on the impact of Artificial Intelligence in the agri-food supply chain
articles.title_cn: 人工智能对农产品供应链影响的系统综述
articles.abstract_en: With a growing global population and escalating concerns over food security, artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology capable of optimizing agricultural processes and improving resource efficiency and security. This systematic review explores the transformative potential of artificial intelligence in the whole agri-food supply chain, focusing on its implications for agricultural productivity and consumer behavior. Using the PRISMA guideline, a total of 64 articles were selected to provide a comprehensive overview of the current state of research on artificial intelligence applications within this domain. Unlike previous reviews, this study leverages cluster analysis to categorize research findings into four main themes: 1) adoption of AI technologies in agriculture, 2) applications of AI in the intermediary management of the supply chain, 3) consumer perceptions and acceptance of AI-powered food innovations, and 4) the role of AI in precision nutrition and personalized health management. The review identifies key benefits of AI, including enhanced decision-making capabilities, improved supply chain transparency, and the facilitation of personalized nutrition strategies. It also highlights significant challenges such as technological accessibility, knowledge gaps among agricultural stakeholders, consumer skepticism, and notable methodological limitations in the existing research. The insights presented in this review contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of the AI’s role in shaping the future of the agri-food supply chain and provide a foundation for policymakers, researchers, and industry stakeholders to develop strategies that maximize the societal and economic benefits of AI integration in the agri-food supply chain.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着全球人口增长和粮食安全问题的日益突出，人工智能（AI）已成为一种能够优化农业流程、提高资源效率和保障安全的变革性技术。本系统综述探讨了人工智能在整个农产品供应链中的变革潜力，重点关注其对农业生产力和消费者行为的影响。采用PRISMA指南，共选取了64篇文章，以全面概述该领域内人工智能应用的研究现状。与以往综述不同，本研究利用聚类分析将研究结果归纳为四个主要主题：1）农业中AI技术的采用，2）AI在供应链中介管理中的应用，3）消费者对AI驱动的食品创新的认知与接受度，以及4）AI在精准营养和个性化健康管理中的作用。综述指出了AI的主要益处，包括增强决策能力、提高供应链透明度以及促进个性化营养策略的实施。同时，它也强调了重大挑战，如技术可及性、农业利益相关者之间的知识差距、消费者怀疑态度以及现有研究中显著的方法论局限性。本综述提供的见解有助于更全面地理解AI在塑造农产品供应链未来中的作用，并为政策制定者、研究人员和行业利益相关者制定策略奠定基础，以最大化AI整合在农产品供应链中的社会和经济利益。

articles.title_en: The role of genotyping in measuring improved variety adoption and impact: advances, challenges, and policy directions
articles.title_cn: 基因分型在衡量改良品种采用及其影响中的作用：进展、挑战与政策方向
articles.abstract_en: Accurate measurement of agricultural technology adoption is critical for evaluating the effectiveness of investments in agricultural research and development. While household surveys have long served as the primary tool for tracking varietal adoption, growing evidence reveals systematic mismatches between self-reported and DNA verified varietal identity. These mismatches arise from distinct local and scientific varietal nomenclatures, complex seed systems, and high varietal release rates. This review examines the emerging role of genotyping, particularly DNA fingerprinting, as a complementary method for varietal identification and adoption measurement. Drawing on a growing body of studies across crops and geographies, we assess how DNA fingerprinting alters adoption estimates, reveals patterns of varietal misclassification, and enhances our understanding of seed system performance. We identify critical design considerations for implementing DNA fingerprinting at scale, including sampling strategies, reference library construction, and integration with standard household surveys. The review also highlights methodological innovations to reduce DNA fingerprinting costs and explores how fingerprinting can inform monitoring, evaluation, and scaling of agricultural innovations. Finally, we outline key research and policy priorities to mainstream DNA fingerprinting into national agricultural systems and to support more evidence-based, accountable, and equitable food policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 准确衡量农业技术采用情况对于评估农业研发投资的有效性至关重要。尽管住户调查长期以来一直是追踪品种采用的主要工具，但越来越多的证据显示，自我报告与DNA验证的品种身份之间存在系统性不匹配。这些不匹配源于不同的地方和科学品种命名法、复杂的种子系统以及高品种释放率。本综述考察了基因分型，特别是DNA指纹分析，作为品种识别和采用衡量补充方法的新兴作用。基于跨作物和地理区域的日益增多的研究，我们评估了DNA指纹分析如何改变采用估计、揭示品种误分类模式，并增强我们对种子系统性能的理解。我们确定了大规模实施DNA指纹分析的关键设计考虑因素，包括抽样策略、参考文库构建以及与标准住户调查的整合。本综述还强调了降低DNA指纹分析成本的方法创新，并探讨了指纹分析如何为农业创新的监测、评估和推广提供信息。最后，我们概述了将DNA指纹分析纳入国家农业系统并支持更具证据基础、问责制和公平性的粮食政策的关键研究和政策优先事项。

articles.title_en: Expanding tenure horizons in food policy research
articles.title_cn: 扩展粮食政策研究中的产权视野
articles.abstract_en: This paper reviews key trends in research, policy, and practice related to tenure over natural resources, especially land. Economic, anthropological, political, legal, and intrahousehold research have all contributed to broadening the understanding of tenure. Evidence shows that tenure security is associated with many development outcomes, especially with long-term investments that can improve productivity, sustainability, and enhance stewardship of resources, resilient livelihoods, and empowerment of rights holders. However, formalization and individualization reforms have not always led to intended benefits, showing the complexity of tenure and the importance of many contextual factors, including existing security offered by informal systems. Growing evidence on effective community management of commons contributed to devolution programs transferring responsibility and rights over forests, rangelands, irrigation and fisheries to user groups. Large-scale land acquisitions in the wake of the 2009 food price crisis created widespread tenure insecurity, especially for communities without documented land rights. The Voluntary Guidelines on the Governance of Tenure were designed to address these problems, but because they remain voluntary, threats of land expropriation remain. Equity of tenure and outcomes of reform programs have become increasingly prominent as civil society groups from peasant movements, Indigenous Peoples, ethnic minorities, women, and youth have taken up issues of land and resource rights. Further transdisciplinary research is needed to identify policy options and implementation processes that can secure land rights for the marginalized, while also considering rights to resources beyond land, especially as economies transition from rural and agrarian to periurban with diversified livelihoods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文回顾了与自然资源（尤其是土地）产权相关的研究、政策和实践的主要趋势。经济学、人类学、政治学、法学和家庭内部分配研究都拓宽了对产权的理解。证据表明，产权保障与许多发展成果相关联，尤其是与能够提高生产力、可持续性、增强资源管理、增强生计韧性以及增强权利持有人赋权的长期投资相关。然而，正规化和个体化改革并不总能带来预期收益，这显示了产权的复杂性以及许多情境因素的重要性，包括非正规系统提供的现有保障。关于社区有效管理公共资源的证据日益增多，促进了将森林、牧场、灌溉和渔业的责任和权利转移给用户群体的权力下放项目。2009年粮食价格危机后的大规模土地收购造成了广泛的产权不安全，尤其是对没有书面土地权利的社区。旨在解决这些问题的《土地权属治理自愿准则》虽然已制定，但由于其仍属自愿性质，土地征用的威胁依然存在。随着农民运动、原住民、少数民族、妇女和青年等民间社会团体开始关注土地和资源权利问题，产权公平和改革项目的成果日益受到重视。需要进一步的跨学科研究来确定能够保障边缘群体土地权利的政策选择和实施过程，同时也要考虑土地以外的资源权利，特别是在经济从农村和农业向城郊多样化生计转型的背景下。

articles.title_en: A review of data linkages for policy-informing research in food and agricultural economics
articles.title_cn: 食品与农业经济学政策研究中的数据链接综述
articles.abstract_en: Researchers commonly use linked data as an empirical tool because information relevant to answer policy questions is often dispersed across multiple sources. To understand how linked data are used in food and agricultural economics research, we conducted a systematic review of 104 peer-reviewed articles, published between 2000 and 2020, in which authors combine data sources to conduct their intended analyses. With our sample of papers, we classify types of data used, describe linkage methods, and summarize empirical approaches. Results show that most studies use public data, and many apply causal methods to examine food policy questions. These patterns highlight the value of public data and the role of linked datasets in food and agricultural economics research. Continued investment in data access, infrastructure, and shared practices for managing and analyzing integrated datasets can strengthen and expand the use of linked data in future research.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究人员通常使用链接数据作为实证工具，因为回答政策问题所需的信息往往分散在多个来源中。为了理解链接数据在食品与农业经济学研究中的使用情况，我们对2000年至2020年间发表的104篇同行评审文章进行了系统综述，这些文章的作者结合了数据源以进行其预期分析。基于我们的论文样本，我们分类了使用的数据类型，描述了链接方法，并总结了实证方法。结果显示，大多数研究使用公共数据，许多研究应用因果方法来考察食品政策问题。这些模式凸显了公共数据的价值以及链接数据集在食品与农业经济学研究中的作用。持续投资于数据访问、基础设施以及管理和分析集成数据集的共享实践，可以加强并扩大未来研究中链接数据的使用。

articles.title_en: China’s food security and food system governance: recent developments and global implications
articles.title_cn: 中国的粮食安全与食物系统治理：近期发展与全球影响
articles.abstract_en: While global progress toward food system transformation for UN Sustainable Development Goals has lagged, China, representing one-sixth of the world’s population, has made significant strides in food security. Previous research has not fully captured China’s recent changes in food consumption and supply, nor adequately addressed food security from a governance perspective. This study examines China’s food system transformation since 2013 through analysis of statistical data, policy documents, and literature, focusing on changes in demand, supply, supply–demand balance, and food system governance. The findings show China’s food system has undergone complex transformations during the last decade. Consumer preferences are shifting toward diverse, high-quality, and nutritious foods, especially animal proteins, while direct grain consumption decreases. This transition has created structural challenges, including dietary imbalances and rising health issues. The supply side, despite increased production and improved capabilities, faces challenges such as declining self-sufficiency rate for certain production, heavy dependence on arable land, and spatial mismatches between production and consumption areas. The supply–demand relationship reveals structural imbalances, particularly in protein supply and feed grain sectors, with quantity-focused approaches leading to simultaneous surpluses and shortages. China’s food security is increasingly challenged by rapidly growing import dependencies and declining self-sufficiency across major agricultural sectors. Food system governance in China has evolved from traditional grain security to a broader food security concept, adopting market-oriented approaches, extending the scope from production to the whole food system, and building a new relationship between stakeholders. Nevertheless, the food system governance needs improvements in assessment mechanisms, government role optimization, framework integration, and stakeholder engagement. The evolution of China’s food security and food system governance generate global impacts through multiple interconnected channels, creating both opportunities and challenges for the international community.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管全球在实现联合国可持续发展目标方面的食物系统转型进展滞后，但中国作为占世界人口六分之一的国家，在粮食安全方面取得了显著进展。以往的研究未能充分捕捉中国在食物消费和供应方面的近期变化，也未从治理角度充分探讨粮食安全问题。本研究通过分析统计数据、政策文件和文献，考察了自2013年以来中国的食物系统转型，重点关注需求、供应、供需平衡以及食物系统治理的变化。研究结果显示，过去十年间，中国的食物系统经历了复杂的转型。消费者偏好正转向多样化、高品质和营养丰富的食品，尤其是动物蛋白，而直接谷物消费则有所下降。这一转型带来了结构性挑战，包括膳食失衡和健康问题日益增多。供应方面，尽管产量增加且能力提升，但仍面临某些产品自给率下降、对耕地高度依赖以及生产与消费区域空间错配等挑战。供需关系揭示了结构性失衡，特别是在蛋白质供应和饲料谷物领域，以数量为导向的方法导致了同时出现过剩和短缺的现象。中国的粮食安全日益受到进口依赖迅速增长和主要农业部门自给率下降的挑战。中国的食物系统治理已从传统的粮食安全演变为更广泛的粮食安全概念，采用市场化方法，将范围从生产扩展到整个食物系统，并构建了利益相关者之间的新型关系。尽管如此，食物系统治理仍需在评估机制、政府角色优化、框架整合和利益相关者参与方面进行改进。中国粮食安全和食物系统治理的演变通过多个相互关联的渠道产生全球影响，为国际社会带来了机遇和挑战。

articles.title_en: Evaluating policy and industry-based interventions for healthier online food-away-from-home choices: A scoping review
articles.title_cn: 评估政策和行业干预措施以促进更健康的线上外出就餐选择：一项范围综述
articles.abstract_en: The rapid digital transformation of the food-away-from-home (FAFH) sector has redefined how consumers access and select meals. Digital delivery platforms such as Uber Eats, Deliveroo, and Meituan have become influential market intermediaries, shaping the nutritional landscape of food environments and raising concerns about their healthfulness. This study reviews empirical evidence on policy-based and industry-led interventions aimed at improving dietary outcomes in digital FAFH environments. Following PRISMA guidelines and using machine-learning–assisted screening (ASReview), 37 peer-reviewed studies were identified across four domains: nutritional labeling, fiscal measures, food-assistance programs, and digital nudges or decision-support tools. Findings indicate that although traditional food-policy instruments designed for physical food environments can be adapted to digital contexts, their effects remain modest and context specific. Industry-led interventions, such as menu reordering, healthier defaults, and real-time basket feedback, show encouraging effects on meal quality and calorie reduction when integrated into online platform design. Opportunities also exist to embed digital policies and personalized decision aids within platform interfaces, providing scalable mechanisms for nutrition governance. Yet regulatory ambiguity, limited transparency, and profit-oriented design incentives constrain their reach. Cross-country disparities in market structure, investment, and institutional capacity further restrict policy diffusion, with most evidence drawn from high-income economies. The review calls for governance frameworks that treat digital food-delivery platforms not as passive outlets but as active infrastructures for public-health policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 外出就餐（FAFH）行业的快速数字化转型重新定义了消费者获取和选择餐食的方式。Uber Eats、Deliveroo 和美团等数字配送平台已成为有影响力的市场中介，塑造了食品环境的营养格局，并引发对其健康性的担忧。本研究回顾了旨在改善数字外出就餐环境中饮食结果的基于政策和行业主导的干预措施的经验证据。遵循 PRISMA 指南并使用机器学习辅助筛选（ASReview），在四个领域识别出 37 篇同行评审研究：营养标签、财政措施、食品援助计划和数字助推或决策支持工具。研究结果表明，尽管为实体食品环境设计的传统食品政策工具可以适应数字环境，但其效果仍然有限且具有情境特异性。行业主导的干预措施，如菜单重排、更健康的默认选项和实时购物篮反馈，在整合到在线平台设计时，对餐食质量和卡路里减少显示出令人鼓舞的效果。还存在将数字政策和个人化决策辅助工具嵌入平台界面的机会，为营养治理提供可扩展的机制。然而，监管模糊性、有限的透明度和以利润为导向的设计激励限制了其覆盖范围。市场结构、投资和制度能力的跨国差异进一步限制了政策扩散，大多数证据来自高收入经济体。该综述呼吁建立治理框架，将数字食品配送平台视为公共卫生政策的积极基础设施，而非被动渠道。

articles.title_en: Agricultural innovation frames, policies, and instruments: evolution, lessons, and future research
articles.title_cn: 农业创新框架、政策与工具：演变、经验教训与未来研究
articles.abstract_en: Scientific and technical innovation offers solutions to many pressing development problems in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in the agriculture sector. However, successful innovation is almost always contingent on an enabling policy environment. This paper reviews the evolution of research on the interaction between agricultural innovation and public policy. It is organized around a sequence of three distinct conceptual frameworks and policy narratives that have shaped this body of research over the past 60 years: the science and technology policy frame, the innovation system policy frame, and the transformative innovation policy and scaling frame. Drawing on seminal studies—both conceptual and empirical—from each frame, we examine their aims and objectives, the policy issues they sought to address, and the methods of analysis used. We then identify and discuss five key agenda points for future research: (1) approaches that provide integrated frameworks, credible data, and novel methods to better assess multiple policy objectives and inform resource allocation in the context of multiple and competing development goals; (2) strategies that inform scaling efforts through a better understanding of how to develop best-fit approaches that take account of local context for scaling innovations for agronomy and natural resource management; (3) solutions-oriented research through action learning, co-design processes, and evaluations that quantify and qualify real-world impacts of the innovation process in a rigorous and nuanced manner; (4) entry points for organizational and institutional reforms to support innovation processes and scaling; and (5) entry points for supporting and accelerating sustainability transitions and systems-transformation. This agenda highlights the need to consider different technological, organizational, and institutional innovations at multiple scales as well as political and economic factors to better inform policy design and execution in a manner that achieves desired outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 科技创新为低收入和中等收入国家许多紧迫的发展问题提供了解决方案，尤其是在农业部门。然而，成功的创新几乎总是依赖于有利的政策环境。本文回顾了农业创新与公共政策相互作用研究的演变过程。文章围绕过去60年间塑造这一研究领域的三个不同概念框架和政策叙事展开：科学与技术政策框架、创新系统政策框架以及变革性创新政策与规模化框架。借鉴每个框架中的开创性研究——包括概念性和实证性研究——我们考察了它们的目标和宗旨、试图解决的政策问题以及所使用的分析方法。随后，我们确定并讨论了未来研究的五个关键议程点：（1）提供综合框架、可靠数据和新颖方法的方法，以更好地评估多重政策目标，并在多重且相互竞争的发展目标背景下为资源配置提供信息；（2）通过更好地理解如何开发考虑当地情境的最佳适配方法来为规模化努力提供信息的策略，以促进农学和自然资源管理的创新规模化；（3）通过行动学习、共同设计过程和评估，以严谨而细致的方式量化和定性创新过程在现实世界中的影响的解决方案导向研究；（4）支持创新过程和规模化的组织和制度改革的切入点；（5）支持和加速可持续转型及系统变革的切入点。这一议程强调需要考虑不同规模的技术、组织和制度创新以及政治和经济因素，以更好地为政策设计和执行提供信息，从而实现预期成果。

articles.title_en: Food Policy at 50 years
articles.title_cn: 《食品政策》50周年
articles.abstract_en: The world’s food systems have changed considerably since the journal Food Policy launched 50 years ago. The journal has evolved along with both the issues most active in prevailing food policy discussions as well as with advances in the theories, methods, data, and evidentiary standards of the policy research community. This article introduces a 50th anniversary special issue, reviews the half-century-long evolution of the journal, and discusses what the patterns apparent therein signal about food policy issues more broadly.
articles.abstract_cn: 自《食品政策》期刊创刊50年来，全球食品体系已发生显著变化。该期刊随着当前食品政策讨论中最活跃的问题以及政策研究界在理论、方法、数据和证据标准方面的进步而演变。本文介绍了50周年特刊，回顾了期刊半个世纪的发展历程，并探讨了其中显现的模式对更广泛的食品政策问题所预示的内容。
